target.shopifyPlanScope: Basic-compatible customer account and online-store flow

checks.name: Native coupon acceptance in a real Shopify checkout

evidence.summary: A previously issued Weletic fixed-amount coupon was accepted by Shopify checkout and reduced the two-item order by JPY 5,000. The coupon value itself is intentionally redacted.
Shopify created order #1001 for two units, accepted the temporary manual staging payment method, and recorded a JPY 5,870 paid total.

checks.name: Real orders/paid webhook retry and persistence

evidence.summary: The original Shopify webhook initially failed because the expired offline token could not refresh without the app environment in the local Next.js process. After restoring that environment and refreshing the offline session, Shopify retried the same webhook identifier; attempt 5 completed and the payload-free audit row is processed with no error.
The checkout coupon transitioned to used, retained its Shopify order reference, and was not returned to the available wallet after refund.
The real paid order created one settled grant and one immutable EARN_ORDER ledger entry for 10,000 points.

checks.name: Real full item and shipping refund

evidence.summary: Shopify refunded both of two units plus shipping, returned the full JPY 5,870 payment, restocked both units, and archived the zero-balance order. No refund-notification email was sent.
The registered refunds/create delivery completed on its first attempt and persisted the two-unit JPY 5,000 item refund.

The live refund exposed an under-clawback: amount-only proportional reversal removed 5,000 of the 10,000 pre-discount points. The engine now treats Shopify's cumulative returned quantity as a floor, a maintenance-only supplemental correction brought the grant and line to 10,000/10,000 reversed, and an immediate replay created no additional ledger entry.
The account returned to zero available and zero pending points, the grant is reversed with zero settled points, and the order-linked coupon remains used.
The temporary Weletic QA manual payment method was deactivated and the manual-payment-method list returned to its original empty baseline.

intentionallyRetained: Shopify order #1001, its refund, and the staging QA tag as immutable audit evidence
Payload-free orders/paid and refunds/create webhook audit rows
The used coupon record and its order linkage
Original and supplemental refund-reversal ledger entries
intentionallySkipped: external partner or multi-merchant service flows
every non-fixed reward type in a real checkout
